attempts.input: Same session. The person changes their mind about Step 1: clicked the h1, chose another card (radio index 1), and pressed the main button 'Pick “Name left, links right” and continue'. Waited 1.5 s, read storage, then pressed 'Previous Step' to look at the reason again.
attempts.observed: The typed reason was deleted with no message. Storage before the new pick: decisions.nav.reason = 'we  book   Xa lot'. After the pick: decisions.nav = {kind:'picked', rejected:[top-centered, split-cta, side-rail], optionId:'top-inline', values:{nav:'top-inline'}}, with no reason field. No notice appeared (.banner, role=status, and role=alert were all empty of any warning). Back on Step 1, the 'Why this choice?' field was empty (''). Cause in the source: pick() in packages/core/src/engine.ts (line 204) builds the new Decision without the earlier reason, while tune() and pickValues() (lines 236 and 247) copy previous.reason across. The only way to recover the reason is the top-bar Undo, which also undoes the new pick. This is saved work lost without saying so (exam question a).

attempts.observed: After the reload no notice appeared and the key held a fresh project. When I seeded from a separate blank page instead, the Studio kept the damaged copy (the attempt above). This is not a finding.
